tech.summary: Asian shares Monday ko gir gaye — Nvidia ki market value early October ke $5.8 trillion se gir kar $3.9 trillion reh gayi hai, Jensen Huang ke shock exit ke baad. Kal (Tuesday) Nvidia ki Q3 earnings aayengi: analysts ko $109 billion revenue aur 90% earnings growth ki umeed hai. Us ke do din baad Anthropic ki trading shuru hogi (ticker ANT) — IPO ne SpaceX se zyada institutional interest khincha hai. FT ke mutabiq Huang ne confidants se CEO wapas aane par bhi baat ki hai.
tech.title: Nvidia ka faisla-kun hafta — earnings kal, Anthropic IPO 19 Nov ko

tech.summary: Google ne 12 Nov ko Gemini 4 Hydrogen introduce kiya: everyday coding aur agentic workflows ke liye bana fast model. 1 million-token context, flat price $1.50 per million input tokens aur $7.50 output. Google ke mutabiq ye Gemini 3.8 Flash se 2.5x tez hai, Terminal-Bench 4.1 par 57% score (Flash ka 18.2%), aur fabricated claims 5x kam. Hydrogen ab Gemini app, AI Studio, API aur Google Search mein globally available hai — Search ki 'ab tak ki sab se bari model upgrade' ke tor par.
tech.title: Google ne Gemini 4 Hydrogen launch kar diya — tez, sasta, har jagah

tech.summary: OpenAI ne apna naya science blog launch kiya aur pehli post mein physicist Nathaniel Craig ne bataya ke GPT-6 Astra ne Standard Model ko lattice (spacetime grid) par define karne ka candidate tareeqa banane mein madad ki — aik aisa masla jo 50 saal se khula tha. Astra ne construction suggest ki aur detailed proof mein lead li; teen lattice experts ne proof review kiya. Craig khud kehte hain ye candidate hai, practical simulation ka tool abhi nahi — reflection positivity jese sawal abhi baqi hain.
tech.title: OpenAI ka GPT-6 Astra — 50 saal purana physics masla hal karne ki taraf

tech.summary: New Delhi ki chip startup Bharat Semi ne $24 million ka all-equity seed round raise kar liya hai — Info Edge, South Park Commons aur Indus Bridge Ventures ne lead kiya. Company programmable image sensors bana rahi hai jo capture, processing aur AI ko aik hi chip par jodte hain; co-founder Vrinda Kapoor ke mutabiq is se system cost 70% tak kam ho sakti hai. Startup abhi pre-revenue hai, General Atomics aur Kaynes Semicon se design wins mil chuke hain, aur commercial production 2027 mein target hai.
tech.title: Bharat Semi ko $24M seed — AI image sensor aik hi chip par

tech.summary: US District Judge Noël Wise ne Samsung, SK hynix aur Micron ke khilaf DRAM price-fixing class action ko kharij karne ki darkhwast mustarad kar di. 17 consumers aur small businesses ka ilzaam hai ke teenon companies ne Oct 2022 se DRAM supply roki aur capacity AI wale HBM ki taraf shift ki — DRAM prices aik saal mein 500% tak barh gayi. Judge ne companies ki 'hum aik doosre ko baaz ki tarah dekhte hain' wali dalil par kaha: 'ye to baazon ka formation mein urnay jesa hai — jo baaz aam tor par nahi karte.' Case ab discovery ki taraf jayega; companies ko 7 Dec tak jawab dena hai.
tech.title: DRAM case aage barhega — judge ne Samsung, SK hynix, Micron ki dismissal kharij kar di

pakistan.summary: Islamabad mein Economic Cooperation Organization (ECO) Council of Ministers ka 30th ijlas 15-16 Nov ko ho raha hai. Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar ne regional cooperation, connectivity aur economic integration mazboot karne par zor diya. Iran ke foreign minister Abbas Araghchi bhi ijlas ke liye Islamabad pahunche. Islamabad mein security high alert par hai aur ijlas aaj (Monday) khatam ho raha hai.
pakistan.title: Islamabad mein ECO ministers ka ijlas — Dar ne regional ties par zor diya

pakistan.summary: Defence Minister Khawaja Asif ne kaha hai ke naye provinces banane par siyasi mashawrat consensus ki taraf barh rahi hai aur 'naya saal naya system dekhega'. President Zardari aur PM Shehbaz ne 14 Nov ko Lahore mein mulaqat mein ittefaq kiya tha ke koi bhi referendum ya naye provinces ka qadam Parliament ko bypass kiye baghair, Constitution ke mutabiq hi hoga. PPP Sindh ki taqseem ke khilaf apne moqaf par qaim hai. Proposal mein 12 provinces ki baat ho rahi hai — Punjab 4, KP aur Balochistan 3-3, Sindh 2.
pakistan.title: Naye provinces par consensus nazdeek — Khawaja Asif

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ki goods exports July-October FY27 mein record $11.4 billion tak pahunch gayi — pichle saal ke $10.4bn ke muqable mein 8.8% izafa, taqreeban $1bn zyada. Government ne is ka credit budget measures ko diya: exporters ke liye kam taxes aur surcharges, tez refunds, behtar export financing. PM Shehbaz ne 2029 tak exports $60 billion tak le jane ka target diya hai. Lekin Gulf markets ko exports mein 6.4% kami bhi aayi, aur trade deficit $14.6bn tak barh gaya.
pakistan.title: Exports record $11.4bn — July-Oct FY27 mein 8.8% izafa

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne T20 Blind Asia Cup ke opening match mein hosts Bangladesh ko 126 runs se hara diya. Pakistan ne pehle batting karte hue 244/6 banaye — Badar Munir ne 43 balls par 88 aur Talha Iqbal ne 33 balls par 68 runs banaye. Jawab mein Bangladesh 118 par all out ho gayi; Kamran Akhtar ne 3 wickets liye. Badar Munir Player of the Match rahe. Pakistan ka agla match aaj Sri Lanka se hai, aur India se muqabla 17 Nov ko hoga.
pakistan.title: Blind Asia Cup: Pakistan ne Bangladesh ko 126 runs se hara diya

pakistan.summary: PPP ne Sunday ko Maulana Fazlur Rehman ke khilaf government ke actions ki mazammat ki — Bilawal Bhutto Zardari ne Fazl se phone par baat kar ke 'siyasi badla' ke khilaf awaaz uthayi, jab ke JUI-F supporters ne protests bhi kiye. Ye qadam siyasi tor par ahem mana ja raha hai, kyun ke PPP aur JUI-F aam tor par aik page par nahi hote.
pakistan.title: Bilawal ne JUI-F ke khilaf 'siyasi badla' ki mazammat ki

pakistan.summary: PM Shehbaz Sharif aur Chief of Defence Forces Field Marshal Asim Munir ne 'The Muslim 500' ki 2027 edition mein joint No. 1 position hasil kar li — Saudi King Salman, Crown Prince MBS aur Turkish President Erdogan ke saath. Jordan ke RISSC ki taraf se compile ki gayi list mein pehli dafa multiple names top par hain; wajah 7 Aug 2026 ko sign hua Makkah Joint Defence Agreement bataya gaya. Mufti Taqi Usmani 7th aur Maulana Tariq Jameel 32nd number par hain.
pakistan.title: Shehbaz aur Asim Munir duniya ke 500 most influential Muslims mein joint No. 1
